description: Changes one or more fields of a playlist: `name`, `coverEmoji` (null removes it), and `songIds`, which REPLACES the whole content and its order. Only the fields you pass move. To reorder, read the playlist with jj_get_playlist first and send the full list back in the new order.

coverEmoji.description: New cover emoji; null removes it.

ifMatch.description: The `updatedAt` you last read for this object. When set, the write is refused with a conflict error if anything changed it since (another device, or the Jam Jam app). Without it, last writer wins. Use it whenever you read, decided, then write.

songIds.description: Ordered content of the playlist; the order is what the user will see and is never re-sorted. Every id must be a live song of this account, otherwise the whole call fails: a half-created playlist would be worse than a refusal.

name: jj_update_playlist
title: Rename, re-cover or reorder a playlist
